**What this is**: The raw auto-compact summary that Claude Code generated when session `2545efef` hit context limit and auto-compacted.

**Source**: JSONL line 1735, timestamp `2026-04-10T17:09:32.943Z`, `isCompactSummary: False`.

**Why this matters**: When auto-compact fires, CC uses its internal `BASE_COMPACT_PROMPT` (verbatim in `services/compact/prompt.ts`) to synthesize the entire session into a single summary message. This message then becomes the FIRST user message in the post-compact live context (replacing all previous turns in memory).
